text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Tenno Sho (Spring) just 
around the corner— Biwa Hayahide seemed to 
show signs of fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian took 1st place in the 
"Satsuki Sho", setting a brand-new course 
record—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That widely celebrated, spectacular feat 
seemed to cast a dark shadow over Biwa 
Hayahide's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...I've always thought of Hayahide as a 
total pain in the neck."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin encourages her— both friend 
and rival— in her own awkward way.
